description: Wi-Fiスポット(中国・繁体語) [telecom] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 佐賀県. 刊載於本網站的設施資訊中，尚包含部分以日語介紹的內容，待翻譯作業完成後，將隨時更新網頁。. Coverage: 佐賀県. The portal files it under the publisher 佐賀県. Its tags are Wi-Fi, インフラ, 観光, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2019-10-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
